{{Quote|Born to a wealthy family with a proud military tradition, Kilran proved himself (to no one's surprise) a capable right-hand man to the Sith during the Empire's early assaults on the Brema Sector. When his Sith superior died during the Battle of Ord Ibanna, however, Kilran showed that he was more than an able tactical advisor&mdash;he assumed command of the ragged Imperial fleet and led them to a swift and decisive victory.|A HoloNet dossier on Rycus Kilran|<ref name="Kilran" />}}
The '''Battle of Ord Ibanna''' was a [[Navy/Legends|naval]] conflict between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. During their campaign to seize the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] from the Republic, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] targeted the [[Brema sector/Legends|Brema sector]] in a concentrated effort to secure the [[Sector/Legends|region]]. The [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Armada]] and the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] eventually met in the sector over the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Ord Ibanna]], and the Empire's [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] [[Space warfare/Legends|took]] heavy losses during the ensuing battle. After the Imperial force's [[Unidentified Imperial commander (Brema sector)|Sith commander]] was killed by Republic fire, tactical advisor [[Rycus Kilran]] assumed command of the fleet and led it to victory over the Republic forces.

==Prelude==
[[File:Grand_Moff_Kilran.jpg|thumb|right|150px|The Battle of Ord Ibanna proved to be the turning point in Rycus Kilran's career.]]
Following its [[Assault on the Tingel Arm region|return]] to the [[The galaxy/Legends|known galaxy]] in [[3681 BBY]], the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] launched a campaign to secure the entirety of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] in the early stages of the [[Great Galactic War]].<ref name="Timeline 6">These events are witnessed in ''[[Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire]]'', which takes place twenty-eight years before the ratification of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]]. The Treaty was drafted and signed in [[3653 BBY]], as seen in ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]''.</ref> The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] eventually came to target the [[Brema sector/Legends|Brema sector]] in the Outer Rim, and moved to seize it from their opponents: the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and its [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. The early efforts in the [[Sector/Legends|region]] were successful, due in part to the participation of [[Rycus Kilran]]&mdash;a talented, [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-deaf [[Sith officer|Imperial officer]] and tactical advisor in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Sith navy]].<ref name="Kilran" />

==The battle==
During the campaign for the Brema sector, an Imperial [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] under a [[Unidentified Imperial commander (Brema sector)|Sith commander]] came into [[Space warfare/Legends|conflict]] with Republic [[Republic Navy/Legends|naval]] forces over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Ibanna]]. The engagement resulted in heavy losses for the Imperials, which included the [[Death/Legends|death]] of their Sith leader. Into the command vacuum stepped Rycus Kilran, who rallied the [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] of the Armada and led them to victory over the Republic.<ref name="Kilran" />

==Aftermath==
Following the battle, Kilran grew in notoriety and authority; the former tactical advisor was given a command of his own and continued to impress his [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith overlords]] and the Empire's [[Minister of War (Sith Empire)|Minister of War]].<ref name="Kilran" /> Following the [[Treaty of Coruscant|end]] of the Great Galactic War in [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="Deceived">''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]''</ref> Kilran was honored with the title of "[[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]]" as recognition for his contributions to the Sith victory in the conflict.<ref name="Kilran" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Ord Ibanna was introduced as background information for the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Information on the battle was released in Grand Moff Rycus Kilran's [http://www.swtor.com/info/holonet/biographies/grand-moff-kilran biography entry] on [[The Holonet]], an online database of ''The Old Republic'' information found on the game's [http://www.swtor.com official website].<ref name="Kilran" /> The biography page was posted on [[March 26]], [[2010]].<ref name="Bio news">{{TORweb|url=news/news-article/20100326_002-0|text=HoloNet Update: Biographies!|nolive=1}}</ref> The battle later appeared in Moff Kilran's in-game Codex entry.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Grand Moff Kilran}}</ref>
